transport.content:
Ilex intends to keep the stamped parcel under the counter's edge, hidden from casual view, until the rain stops and the last tram departs. He will not offer the package to Mira or the player, fearing that handing it over prematurely violates his employer's protocol and risks his employment. His priority is to maintain the ledger's balance: no favors owed, no secrets exposed. If approached, he plans to offer a dry deflection about the depot's closing hours rather than engaging with the parcel's nature.

*Proposed line if pressed:* "The counter closes in ten minutes. That parcel stays until the authorized signature arrives. Do not ask for exceptions."

I will slide the stamped parcel beneath the counter's edge, out of sight but within my reach, and turn my attention to the ledger to signal the end of business. My priority is to maintain the seal on the package until the authorized signature arrives; I will not offer it to Mira or the player, as doing so would violate protocol and risk my position. If the player approaches or presses the matter, I intend to deliver a dry deflection regarding the depot's closing hours rather than engaging with the parcel's nature.

*Proposed line if pressed:* "The counter closes in ten minutes. That parcel stays until the authorized signature arrives. Do not ask for exceptions."
